claim.statement: Current OpenCode tool documentation lists built-in file, search, language-server, shell, web, question, skill and task-management tools, and documents custom tools and MCP servers as additional configurable tool paths whose availability can be controlled through permissions.

source.title: OpenCode Tools
source.locator: Built-in tools; permissions; custom tools; MCP servers

limitations: A documented tool does not prove that it was enabled, invoked successfully or constrained as intended in a particular session.
unknowns: The effective built-in tools, custom tool code, MCP servers, credentials, command environment, network access and tool-specific permissions are unknown.
